title: Independent recompilation and axiom audit of the public Lean development on four-dimensional Yang-Mills existence: what was run, what passed, what was not checked (report v1.1)
description:
Independent recompilation and axiom audit of the public Lean development on four-dimensional Yang–Mills existence (report v1.1, 12 November 2026; first deposit).

What the report is. A reproducibility report on the public repository yang-mills-group/OpenAI-YM-20261028 (commit 3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464): what was recompiled and checked on 11 November 2026, with the recorded results, and what was not checked. It does not assess the mathematics, the faithfulness of the formal statement or any priority question. The checked proposition is an existence statement; no mass-gap statement is concerned.

Recorded results. Full builds under Lean 4.32.0 (twice) and 4.32.2, return code 0, 9470 project objects; our axiom query and the three verification scripts supplied by the repository pass (the three headline theorems depend on propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only); the exported proof closure (145151 declaration records, 3224695689 bytes, SHA-256 f1ff87d70c21f2f2d620d23bb0596a6947cabc3e32ff7ec5725c7a0e7089a06c) is identical in the two 4.32.0 builds. Checkers other than Lean's own kernel: nanoda ended with a capacity panic and gave no verdict (an instrumented run finished 187924 of 187925 items, no rejection); nano-lean reported 187925 items attempted, 0 failures; logos-kernel returned code 0 and reported 180988 declarations accepted (the difference from 187925 is not explained); lean4lean returned code 0 for 9465 of the 9470 modules and refused none (state read on 12 November 2026 at 05:20 CET: five modules pending; the reruns were in progress). The fast controls were replayed by a non-author; outputs identical apart from durations, process numbers, memory figures and one file path. Two observations on the repository are reported in neutral terms (four records of the release carrying two different digests for one file; a metaprogram that generates 156 declarations, 146 of them used). A partial port to Lean 4.35.0 was attempted and stopped (1505 of 9470 project objects at the last build).

Limits. Same machine and operator for all runs; three of the four checkers read the same export file; no network isolation on the rented machine; the nanoda verdict is incomplete; the lean4lean pass is incomplete; lean4lean is written in Lean; the repository's definitions are not appraised. Prepared with the assistance of language models (GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Sonnet 5.5); not refereed; no human has checked the proofs; no priority claim.

Contents. The note (PDF and LaTeX) and a supplement with our scripts as run, our Lean control files, logs, hashes and the replay by a non-author. No code of the repository under study, of the checkers or of the kernels is redistributed.
